Class UserDbRepository

java.lang.Object
repository.db.UserDbRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<Long,User>, UserRepository
public class UserDbRepository extends Object implements UserRepository
Placeholder for user database persistence. Stores constructor arguments only; no connection, validation or CRUD operation is implemented.
